5287: Private RV park on US 65 south of Harrison, a gateway to the Buffalo National River, with gravel sites, cable TV, a pool and a game room. --Claude
5288: Private campground on Highway 206 east of Harrison, with cabins and tent sites: 24 full-hookup sites, 9 with water and electric and 7 with electric only. --Claude
5298: Private RV park in Kensett, just outside Searcy, formerly Whitney Lane RV, with level gravel sites, concrete patios and pavilions. --Claude
5302: Private RV park and general store at Mt. Olive, near Melbourne and a White River trout access, with level, partly shaded gravel sites, tent sites and a cabin. --Claude
5308: Private RV park in Mountain View, a few minutes' walk from the music and restaurants around the Court Square, with level gravel sites, cable TV, a rental cabin and a 90-seat theater that hosts open music jams. --Claude
5309: Private RV park and guest motel on North Bayou Drive in Mountain View, a few minutes from the town square and the Ozark Folk Center, with concrete and gravel pads and a bathhouse. --Claude
5311: Private RV park four blocks from the Mountain View town square, with a bathhouse.  It has 50 full-hookup sites and 13 with electric only; 14 of the sites are pull-throughs. --Claude
5315: Private RV park about a mile from Crater of Diamonds State Park and a mile from downtown Murfreesboro, with a bathhouse: 13 full-hookup RV sites, 5 tent sites with electric and 3 cabins. --Claude
5325: Family-run RV park and cabins in Plainview, next to Harold Blalock City Park and near Nimrod Lake and the Ouachita National Forest, with kayak rentals and guided river trips. --Claude
5333: Family-owned RV park off Highway 412 near Springdale, with a pool, a playground, a game room, tent sites and cabins. --Claude
5337: Private RV park at Vilonia on the grounds of a decommissioned Titan II missile complex, which also has an event center and a bed and breakfast, with gravel sites for big rigs and tent sites. --Claude
5553: City of Worthington campground in Olson Park, near Lake Okabena, with bathhouses, a boat landing, the trail around the lake and a dog park: 58 sites with electric and 5 primitive ones, with water from central taps. --Claude
5570: Family-owned RV park just southeast of Bemidji off Highways 2 and 71, with cable TV and a dog park: 62 full-hookup sites and 3 tent sites.  In October 2026 its website said storm damage had put the shower house and laundry out of use for the time being. --Claude
5585: RV park at Treasure Island Resort & Casino near Welch, with big-rig full-hookup pads, 88 of them pull-throughs, and a free shuttle to the casino; a separate campground by the beach and marina has sites without hookups. --Claude
5595: RV campground opened in 2023-24 in Nevis, across County 2 from Daisy Lake and within walking distance of downtown, connected to the Paul Bunyan State Forest ATV trails, with camper rentals, cabins and a tent area. --Claude
5606: Itasca County Land Department park on Bass Lake, 11 miles east of Effie, with electric sites in A Loop, non-electric ones in B Loop and 6 tent-only sites, each with a picnic table and fire grate.  Sites 15B and 16B are first-come, first-served, paid at the pay boxes. --Claude
5614: City of Silver Bay campground on Lake Superior's North Shore, beside Black Beach Park, with an ATV trail from the campground.  It opened in 2020, so the trees are still young and shade is thin.  34 sites have full hookups and 15 electric only; the electric-only sites take rigs up to 35 feet.  The nearest boat launch is at the Silver Bay Marina, about 5 miles south. --Claude
5637: City of Hill City campground in Hill Lake Park, overlooking the lake, with a sandy swimming beach, a fishing dock, a boat landing, a picnic shelter, a playground and a rustic camper cabin: 8 full-hookup sites, 9 with water and electric, and tent sites. --Claude
5644: Itasca County Land Department campground at the fairgrounds in Grand Rapids, among tall red and white pines, renovated in 2023, with a wash house: nearly 40 full-hookup sites, 6 grassy sites with electric and 10 rustic ones.  The fairgrounds' Trailhead Building is the information center for the Mesabi bike trail. --Claude
5686: City of Melrose campground in Sauk River Park, downtown, overlooking the river, with remodeled restrooms: 15 sites with water and electric, each with a grill and a picnic table. --Claude
5797: Private overnight RV park in Mitchell off I-90 exit 330, with an outdoor pool, a game room and a cabin; 11 of the sites are pull-throughs. --Claude
5847: Small City of Montrose campground in Pioneer Park, near the East Fork of the Vermillion River and next to the community pool. --Claude
5923: Private RV park just west of Minot off the US 2/52 bypass, in woods near a bend of the Souris (Mouse) River, with a playground and 24-hour access: 119 RV sites and 15 tent sites. --Claude
